Public Notice of Availability of Draft Environmental Impact Report for Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project, Cambridge, Massachusetts, Project No. R-107.
July 8, 1977, The On Massachusetts Secretary of the 
Executive Office of Environmental 
'Affairs (EOEA) published in the Environmental Monitor a notice of the availability of a Draft En-Impact vironmental Report submitted (DEIR) DY Massachusetts Department of Community Affairs, for the Kendall · Square Urban Renewal Project in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
The DEIR is equivalent to the Draft Environmental Impact Statement (DEIS) prepared by the Federal Department of Housing, and Urban Development (HUD) and accepted by the Massachusetts Department of Community Affairs for the purposes of circulation and review in accordance with governing regulations under the provisions of the Massachusetts Environmental Policy Act (MEPA).
EOEA is requesting comments on the DEIR from interested parties. The comments should be transmitted to EOEA within 30 days of the date of publication in the Environmental Monitor of the notice of availability of the DEIR. Therefore, comments should be transmitted to EOEA by August 8, 1977.
Copies of the DEIR are available for reading by the public in the Messachusetts Office of Environmental Affairs, 100 Cambridge Street, Boston, Massachusetts.
Please send comments on the DEIR to:
Executive Office of Environmental Affairs
Commonwealth of Massachusetts
MEPA Section
100 Cambridge Street
Boston, Massachusetts 02202
CAMBRIDGE REDEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
Public Notice of Availability of Draft Environemental Impact Statement for Kendell Square Urban Renewal Project, Cambridge; Massachusetts, HUD Project No. R-107.
On July 1, 1977, the Council on Environmental Quality published in the Federal Register a notice of the availability of a Draft Environmental Impact Statement (DEIS) prepared by the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) for the Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
. HUD is requesting comments on the DEIS from interested parties. The comments should be transmitted to HUD within 45 days of the date of publication in the Federal Register of the notice of availability of the DEIS. Therefore, comments should be transmitted to HUD by August 15, 1977.
Copies of the DEIS are available for reading by the public in the Cambridge City Clerk's Office, Cambridge City Hall; the main Cambridge Public Library, ". Broadway, Cambridge; Cambridge Redevelopment Authority's Office, 336 Main Street, Cambridge; HUD Regional Office Library in the J.F. Kennedy Building, Boston, Massachusetts; and the HUD Area Office, 15 New ... Chardon Street, Boston, Massachusetts.
